description: This PHP class defines the DProduct function, which multiplies values in a database column based on specified criteria, mimicking the Excel DPRODUCT function within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: DProduct
classes.description: Represents the DPRODUCT function that computes the product of a column in a database matching given criteria, akin to its Excel counterpart.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the DPRODUCT function by extracting the relevant field from the database and returning the product of the filtered column values, or an error if the field is invalid.
